title: Changes in Latitude | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Changes in Latitude is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Hoping for a home that’s close to the coast and even closer to the 30A way of life? Changes in Latitude is a five bedroom, four and a half bath retreat tucked away on the peaceful west end of Santa Rosa Beach. Just 0.6 miles from Ed Walline Public Beach Access and north of Scenic Highway 30A, this home welcomes up to 12 guests. A complimentary 6 seater street legal golf cart and 4 bikes give you the freedom to explore nearby spots like Gulf Place Town Center, where the neighborhood vibe comes alive with open air cafes, live music, and locally owned shops.Inside, the space is thoughtfully designed to bring people together. The open concept living area offers plenty of plush seating and a flat screen TV, while large doors open out to your own private heated pool, great for afternoon dips or lounging with your group. The fully stocked kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, a blender, coffee maker, toaster, microwave, and a spacious island that seats six, perfect for sharing meals or late night snacks. A dedicated dining space makes room for everything from home cooked dinners to board game tournaments. On the main floor, a king bedroom with TV and ensuite bath provides comfort and privacy, along with a laundry room and half bath for added convenience.Upstairs, a second living area with a sleeper sofa creates a relaxed space for movie nights or quiet mornings. Four more bedrooms are located here, including a second primary suite with private balcony access and its own full bath. The bunk room is a fun hideaway for kids, offering them their own space to relax after a day filled with sun, sand, and local adventures.Sleeping Arrangements:First Floor* Primary Bedroom: King Bed, TV, ensuite bathroom (Tub + Walk in Shower)Second Floor* 2nd Primary Bedroom: King Bed, TV, Balcony access, Private Bathroom* Guest Room: Queen Bed, TV, Private Bathroom* Guest Room: Queen Bed, TV, Shared Bathroom* Bunk Room: Twin over Twin Bunks* 2nd Living Area: Full size pull out sofa bedHead outside and make the most of your time in Santa Rosa Beach. Lounge by your private pool or heat it seasonally for a relaxing dip after a day out. Fire up the grill for a casual evening cookout with friends and family, then take the golf cart for a quick ride to the shoreline.What’s NearbyLocated on the west end of 30A, this home places you within easy reach of some of Santa Rosa Beach’s most loved local spots. Walk, bike, or take the golf cart to Gulf Place Town Center, a hub of live music, art galleries, and locally owned boutiques. Craving something casual? Try Pizza by the Sea or grab fresh Gulf seafood and cocktails with a view at Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar. Cool off with handcrafted sweets at Pecan Jacks Ice Cream, or ease into your morning with a brew from Sunrise Coffee Co.For dinner, enjoy a relaxed meal at Local Catch, take in sunset views from Vue on 30a, or enjoy Italian favorites at Mimmo’s Ristorante. With everything from beachside bites to evening dining just minutes away, every day offers a chance to explore the flavors and character that make this area a true 30A gem.Your stay at Changes in Latitude comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:* Snowbird Friendly!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 3 cars with no street parking.* The private pool can be heated seasonally for an additional fee.A starter set of amenities is provided: The kitchen includes paper towels, a sponge, dish soap, dishwasher pods, kitchen wipes, trash liners, and laundry pods. Each bathroom has toilet paper, facial and bath soaps, body wash, shampoo, and conditioner. Towels include one body towel and washcloth per guest, plus two hand towels per bathroom.
